model.scope: One weighted prefix or suffix slot; affix-count progression remains owned by ProgressiveAffixesPlugin.
model.levelAxis: The governed MagicPrefix/MagicSuffix level and maxlevel fields are evaluated against item level.
model.typeResolution: Concrete spawnable Armor/Weapons/Misc type plus transitive ItemTypes Equiv ancestry.
model.exclusions: etype ancestry and classspecific restrictions are applied before weighting.
model.probability: frequency divided by total eligible frequency.
model.groups: Reported as an exclusion surface; multi-slot ordering is outside this one-slot model.
model.sampling: Deterministic xorshift32 checks the exact affected-affix probability mass.
